observations.title: Production build false positives
observations.technical_explanation: Both scanner signals (obfuscated-code, short-identifiers) are false positives caused by the normal minification process of Vite and React's production build. The file is a legitimate bundled output with no intentional obfuscation or hidden functionality.
observations.layman_explanation: The extension's code looks compact because of the build tool, not because of hidden tricks. This is how many modern web extensions work.

observations.title: Bundled React URL sanitization is present
observations.technical_explanation: The bundled code contains React's built-in 'go' function that blocks javascript: URLs as a security precaution, and handlers for attributes like xlink:href that pass through this sanitization. This is a standard security feature of React, not a vulnerability.
observations.layman_explanation: The bundled code includes safety measures from React that prevent dangerous URL types, which is a good thing for security.
